statement.p: Suppose we form 5-letter "words" using the letters A, B, C, D, E, F, G.
How many such words are possible for each of the following conditions?
(a) No condition is imposed: Preview Question 1 Part 1 of 5
(b) No letter can be repeated in a word: Preview Question 1 Part 2 of 5
(c) Each word must begin with the letter A: Preview Question 1 Part 3 of 5
(d) The letter C must be at the end: Preview Question 1 Part 4 of 5
(e) The second letter must be a vowel. Preview Question 1 Part 5 of 5
